label: Offline demonstration evidence bundled with Omevra. Illustrative items written for the demo provider, pointing at real, well-known resources a reader can check. This is not live database access and these items are not a clinical classification.

items.statement: BRCA1 c.68_69delAG (historically 185delAG) is recorded in ClinVar with pathogenic interpretations for hereditary breast and ovarian cancer syndrome.

items.citation: OMIM entry for BRCA1 and breast-ovarian cancer susceptibility
items.statement: BRCA1 loss of function is an established mechanism of hereditary breast and ovarian cancer susceptibility, and c.68_69delAG is a frameshifting founder variant described in that literature.
CFTR c.1521_1523delCTT, encoding p.Phe508del, is classified as pathogenic for cystic fibrosis by multiple clinical laboratory submitters in ClinVar.

items.citation: Cutting GR. Cystic fibrosis genetics: from molecular understanding to clinical application. Nature Reviews Genetics 2015;16:45-56
items.statement: p.Phe508del is the most common cystic fibrosis-causing CFTR variant worldwide and acts by protein misfolding and premature degradation, as reviewed by Cutting (2015).
OMIM records cystic fibrosis as an autosomal recessive disorder caused by biallelic CFTR variants, with p.Phe508del the predominant allele in many populations.

items.citation: Omevra bundled illustrative examples, CFTR entry
items.statement: The deletion c.1521_1523delCTT removes three bases and therefore deletes one residue without shifting the reading frame, an in-frame deletion.
Sickle cell disease is an autosomal recessive haemoglobinopathy caused by the HBB sickle variant, with deoxygenated haemoglobin S polymerising in red cells.

items.citation: Peer-reviewed literature on haemoglobin S polymerisation, indexed in PubMed
items.statement: The glutamic acid to valine substitution in beta globin produces haemoglobin S, whose polymerisation on deoxygenation is the molecular basis of red cell sickling.

items.citation: Omevra bundled illustrative examples, HBB entry
items.statement: The sickle variant is a single nucleotide substitution, c.20A>T in HBB, and is one of the textbook examples of a pathogenic missense variant.
